2607.14252.title: MEMORA: Embodied Action Memory from Egocentric Videos for Reasoning and Planning
2607.14252.paper_summary: Long-horizon robot planning requires more than predicting what actions will do next; it also requires memory of the embodied experience that makes future goals interpretable. People do not plan from the present scene alone: they draw on remembered places, object-state changes, prior procedures, and regularities revealed through repeated action. We formulate Embodied Action Memory (EAM) as the capability to form, maintain, and use such experience as a persistent memory state for later decisions. MEMORA realizes EAM with a formation-consolidation-retrieval lifecycle and four typed stores: Environment Memory, Entity Memory, Activity Memory, and Inferred Knowledge. Online editing maintains object identities and state histories as new observations arrive; offline consolidation abstracts repeated experience into reusable procedures and participant-specific regularities. MEMORA-Bench evaluates this lifecycle on 45 hours of EPIC-KITCHENS-100 extension video across 18 participants through memory-grounded planning, including previously unseen goals, and a complementary memory-assessment task. Across four open-weight language models, full MEMORA--combining editing, typed stores, and consolidation--achieves the strongest aggregate results among the evaluated memory conditions. It improves memory-assessment accuracy by up to 20.5 points over the strongest controlled baseline and improves out-of-distribution Robot-Grounded Plan score by up to 16.6% relative. A qualitative two-task robot deployment study further illustrates how memory-grounded language plans can interface with downstream control, while the overall results show that editable, consolidated memory can supply remembered context for robot planning. Project page: https://yuzihaowashu.github.io/MEMORA/
2607.14252.paper_summary_zh: 長期機器人規劃不僅需要預測接下來會採取的行動；還需要對具身經驗的記憶，使未來的目標可解釋。人們並不是僅僅根據當前場景進行規劃：他們會依賴記憶中的地方、物體狀態變化、先前的程序以及通過重複行動揭示的規律。我們將具身行動記憶（EAM）定義為形成、維持和使用這種經驗的能力，作為持久的記憶狀態以供未來決策使用。MEMORA 通過形成-鞏固-檢索的生命周期和四種類型的存儲來實現 EAM：環境記憶、實體記憶、活動記憶和推斷知識。隨著新觀察的到來，線上編輯維護物體的身份和狀態歷史；離線鞏固則將重複的經驗抽象為可重用的程序和特定參與者的規律。MEMORA-Bench 在 18 名參與者的 45 小時 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 擴展視頻上評估了這一生命周期，通過基於記憶的規劃，包括以前未見的目標，以及一個補充的記憶評估任務。在四個開放權重的語言模型中，完整的 MEMORA——結合了編輯、類型存儲和鞏固——在評估的記憶條件中達到了最強的綜合結果。它將記憶評估的準確性提高了高達 20.5 分，相對於最強的控制基線，並將分佈外的機器人基礎計劃分數提高了高達 16.6%。一項質性兩任務機器人部署研究進一步說明了基於記憶的語言計劃如何與下游控制接口，而整體結果顯示可編輯的、鞏固的記憶可以為機器人規劃提供記憶的上下文。項目頁面：https://yuzihaowashu.github.io/MEMORA/
